headline: An unpriced bolt-on by a unit: Arch's North American insurance arm buys an auto F&I provider
reasoning: Source: Arch Capital's 8-K filed 16:20 ET, item 7.01: 'Arch Insurance North America, part of Arch Capital Group Ltd. ... announced that it had entered into an agreement to acquire Premier Dealer Holding Corp., a Dublin, Ohio-based provider of automotive finance and insurance products'. No price is given.

What changed: a small unpriced acquisition by a unit of a $36B insurer. Material deals are priced; this one is not, and it was furnished under 7.01. After hours on the consolidated tape: 105.75, -0.57%.
